name: BOYNEXTDOOR Tomodachi Base
overview: BOYNEXTDOOR’s first-ever Japan-exclusive talk variety show, “BOYNEXTDOOR Tomodachi Base,” has been greenlit! The series will premiere on Nippon TV on Saturday, April 11, 2026, at 2:30 p.m. (8 episodes total). Following the broadcast, the episodes will be available on Hulu, TVer, and Nippon TV TADA (scheduled). Today, ahead of the premiere, the show’s logo was unveiled.
